translations.web: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
translations.bsb: So tell them: As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you exactly as I heard you say.
translations.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do
translations.asv: Say unto them, As I live, saith Jehovah, surely as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
